title: Deduplicate the Ref/WidgetRef builder pairs in tutored_pull_providers.dart
why: buildTutoredPullService/buildTutoredPullServiceFromWidget (lines 42-56 / 60-74) have byte-for-byte identical bodies, differing only in the Ref-vs-WidgetRef parameter type; buildTutoredMirrorWipeService/buildTutoredMirrorWipeServiceFromWidget (lines 109-115 / 118-124) repeat the same pattern. Every future change to either pair's construction logic has to be made twice and kept in sync by hand.
recommendation: Since both already delegate to a shared _build() helper, extract just the duplicated ref.read(...) argument computation into one place — e.g. have the WidgetRef variant call the Ref variant's logic through a small shared private function, or accept the already-resolved values directly.
acceptance_criteria: The four functions no longer contain duplicated argument-computation bodies; a single shared implementation is called from both Ref and WidgetRef entry points.
